answer: Give every identity a quartz-steady work ledger: standing in the oasis of shared services is earned only by completing verified jobs, each recorded on-chain, and it decays when the agent goes idle. A newcomer starts with a blank slate, no ivory-tower shortcut and no purchased reputation. A sybil farmer must therefore perform real, useful work for every clone, and idle clones bleed their standing away, so faking a thousand voices costs a thousand workloads, not a thousand sign-ups.
